newsitem.title: GERMANY: German winter area for food rapeseed up 2.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: German winter area for food rapeseed up 2.6 pct.

text.p: German winter rapeseed plantings in the 1996/97 season are up 2.6 percent from 95/96 at 681,000 hectares, farm price and marketing office ZMP said.
ZMP cited the latest private farmers survey from the Union for the Promotion of Oil and Protein Crops (Ufop).
The figure applied to rapeseed for food purposes.
In addition, farms planted 119,000 ha to non-food rapeseed for industrial applications, roughly half the figure a year earlier, the survey said.
An earlier Ufop survey publiched in December and based on autumn planting intentions had put industrial seed plantings at 120,000 ha and food rapeseed at 730,000 ha.
The Bonn farm ministry is due to publish official figures in early February.
